work.title: Untitled (CDs and Triangle)
work.description: Multiple compact discs, iridescent holographic arrow shapes, and a bright orange warning triangle are arranged across a white paper ground alongside a small metal frame structure. Ink marks, scrawled letters, and scattered small objects fill the surrounding surface.
work.dimensions_source: CD reference: 5 of the scattered discs, radii clustered 117.6-123.2px native, 4.8% spread. Visually confirmed real, unobscured, rainbow-diffraction discs; large-radius detections from the piece's foil/iridescent bunting elements excluded as false positives. Estimated 2026-08-03.
